label: Palestinians Killed (Gaza)
source: Gaza Ministry of Health / UN OCHA / WAFA / IMEMC (Sep 20, 2026)
contestNote: Israel disputes figures, argues Hamas fighters counted as civilians. Cumulative total since Oct 7, 2023, incl. 21,500+ children; 8,000+ people still missing under rubble Strip-wide (some estimates 4,000-5,000; an estimated 8,000 more bodies believed buried per Gaza civil defence, Sep 6). Lancet Mortality Survey (Mar 2026) estimates 75,200 violent deaths through Jan 5, 2025 — 34.7% higher than MoH for same period. Netanyahu rejected the US/Board of Peace 15-point Gaza roadmap Aug 9, 2026 despite Hamas acceptance; Israel says no IDF withdrawal until Hamas is genuinely disarmed. Board of Peace statement Aug 12 says IDF withdrawal beyond the Yellow Line awaits full Hamas decommissioning of light/heavy weapons and tunnels. 1,393+ killed and 4,822+ wounded since the Oct 2025 ceasefire took effect, incl. 831 bodies recovered from rubble (Gaza Health Ministry via WAFA, Sep 20); UN spokesperson Stephane Dujarric said Aug 31 the UN remains 'very concerned about the impact on civilians because of the continued Israeli airstrikes.' Board of Peace envoy Mladenov warned the UN Security Council Aug 26 that a ceasefire collapse would be a 'point of no return for everyone.'
delta: Sep 20 (346th consecutive ceasefire-violation day): IDF/Shin Bet disclose killing three Hamas operatives over the weekend — Yahya Hamdouna and Mohammad Rafa'i (both Daraj-Tuffah Battalion, Oct 7 participants) and Basir al-Barsh, whom the military names a Nukhba commander; the third matches Basir al-Bursh, son of Health Ministry chief Munir al-Bursh, whose family disputes the militant characterization. Two more wounded by gunfire near Khan Younis. Sep 19 (345th day): a drone strike kills Basir al-Bursh, 28, in Jabalia's az-Zahra neighborhood while he helps fill water containers; a separate drone strike on a vehicle in Sheikh Radwan, Gaza City, kills 24-year-old Mohammad Khaled al-Refa'ey and wounds 4+; a Shujaiya strike kills 1 more; a girl dies of Friday's gunfire wounds near Nuseirat. Ceasefire-period toll reaches 1,393 killed, 4,822 wounded; cumulative toll reaches 73,910 killed, 174,935 wounded. Sep 18 (344th consecutive ceasefire-violation day): Israeli soldiers shoot and kill Karam Mus'ad al-Masar'a on Julis Street in the Nuseirat refugee camp; two more Palestinians wounded near Nasser Medical Complex, west of Khan Younis, bringing to five the number wounded there since Thursday afternoon. Sep 17 (343rd day): Israeli drone strikes kill Youssef al-Zaim near the 17th Roundabout in western Gaza City and Mohammad Nasser Suleiman al-Bayouk in Nahr al-Bared, Khan Younis; a strike on Ad-Daraj School in central Gaza City wounds two, and a Sheikh Ajlin drone strike wounds around 10; Sa'id Barham dies of earlier strike wounds; IDF discloses killing Hamas Nukhba operative Muhammad Jamal Ahmad Eid (Bureij) and naval-force platoon commander Saleh Ziad Ibrahim Miqdad (Gaza City). Gaza Health Ministry reports 5 killed, 28 wounded strip-wide in 24 hrs; ceasefire-period toll reaches 1,386 killed, 4,784 wounded. Sep 16: A war-damaged six-storey building (Al-Saada) collapses overnight in western Gaza City, killing at least 21 (incl. 12 children) and wounding 14, with dozens still missing under the rubble; separately, an Israeli 'double-tap' drone strike in Sheikh Radwan, north Gaza City, wounds a Civil Defence paramedic then kills 15-year-old Mohammad Abdul Zinati as he goes to help him; IDF strikes overnight also kill a Hamas commander in northern Gaza and two more militants. Ceasefire-period toll reaches 1,381 killed, 4,757 wounded. Sep 15: IDF and Shin Bet say they killed Hamas Rafah Brigade commander Nael Abu Obeid in a southern Gaza Strip strike after weeks of tracking; separate strikes destroy four tents and kill two at the Abu Khadra displacement camp, central Gaza. Sep 14: IDF says it killed Hamas Jabaliya Battalion commander Ahmad Batash in northern Gaza overnight — at least the fifth Hamas commander eliminated that week; Gaza Health Ministry reports 2 more killed, 25 wounded strip-wide in 24 hrs, incl. 8 wounded (4 children) in Khan Younis tent strikes. Sep 13: Israeli drone strike on a vehicle in Tal al-Hawa, western Gaza City, kills two people IDF says were Hamas engineers, wounds 13; medics say the bodies were too dismembered to identify. Sep 12: Israeli drone strikes hit displaced Palestinians' tents in Al-Mawasi, west of Khan Younis, including near the Shahd Rest Area; 4-9 wounded (reports vary), no fatalities. Sep 7: Israeli strikes kill 5 across Gaza in 24 hrs — a drone strike kills Mohammad Sukkar (28) in Rimal, Gaza City; a vehicle strike kills Yousef Aqila and his 7-year-old daughter Wafaa in western Gaza City as they returned from buying school supplies; an artillery strike on the Sakina School shelter in Deir al-Balah kills 7-year-old Saadi Ghalia; Hassan Ali Saqallah (19) also killed in Gaza City; 17 more wounded strip-wide. IDF separately discloses killing PIJ operative al-Batrihi in Shati camp (Sep 6) and Hamas Nukhba member Khalas in a prior strike, plus a mid-air munition diversion to avoid civilians. US envoy Kushner says Israel's government is acting 'a little irrational' on Gaza due to next month's election. Sep 6: Israeli strike kills 2, incl. a girl, in Al-Nasr, Gaza City; Gaza City holds a mass funeral for 100 people (incl. 60 children) recovered from Zeitoun rubble; 8 Muslim-majority nations warn of 'grave consequences' over Katz/Ben Gvir Gaza-displacement proposals; Netanyahu says he 'attacked Qatar' and defends Qatari aid-fund transfers to Gaza. Sep 5: rescue teams recover remains of 55 Malka family members from Zeitoun rubble; a new Freedom Flotilla mission sets sail toward Gaza, expected in October; US Ambassador Huckabee denies any Israeli plan to forcibly displace Gazans. Sep 4: US State Department publicly rejects Israeli displacement plans, citing Point 12 of Trump's peace plan guaranteeing no forced departure from Gaza. Sep 3: Israeli drone strike on Rimal kills a 13-year-old; IDF shoots dead two Palestinians crossing the Yellow Line near Beit Lahia; National Security Minister Ben Gvir unveils 'Disengagement 710,' a plan to remove 1.86 million Palestinians from Gaza over seven years. Sep 2: Gaza Health Ministry reports 8 killed, 31 wounded in 24 hrs (cumulative toll 73,470+); Israeli drone strike and gunfire kill 2 more in Jabalia town/refugee camp, hitting displacement tents and a civilian gathering; ceasefire-period toll reaches 1,334 killed, 4,429 wounded. Defense Minister Katz says Israel is 'organised and prepared' to remove Gaza's population 'by any means' once Trump approves, calling the plan merely 'frozen'; Netanyahu visits an IDF post in Gaza and says Israel will not withdraw from territory it controls. Sep 1: Shin Bet commandos raid the Al Katiba area of western Gaza City, capturing wounded Hamas internal security chief Muein al-Arabid; IAF strikes cover the operation, killing at least 3 (incl. al-Arabid's wife) and wounding 8; separately, Israeli strikes elsewhere in Gaza kill at least 4 more including children. Aug 31: Israeli drone strikes kill 5 in Gaza City — 2 near the municipal park (residential building entrance, displaced-family area) and 3 in a vehicle strike in Tal al-Hawa; IDF says both hit Ezzedine al-Qassam Brigades operatives. Ceasefire-period toll reaches 1,318 killed, 4,375 wounded. Aug 30: IDF says it killed Nukhba company commander Hani Abd al-Hai Fakhri Mazloum and sniper Hassan Zidan Hassan Deiri in northern Gaza; a separate Deir al-Balah strike kills Hamas operative Hassam Osama Hussein Nasir and 3-year-old Tayyem Hamdan. Aug 29: Israeli strikes kill at least 6 more Palestinians — 2 in a Gaza City drone strike on an electric bike, 1 in Khan Younis, 1 by gunfire in al-Musaddar village, plus 2 more Nukhba Force members (Yasser Abu al-Khair, Mohammed al-Din) killed in a separate Khan Younis strike and Nukhba cmdr Abd al-Fatah Abu al-Eish (Oct 7 participant) and operative Raed Adel Mohammed Alyan killed in Jabalia; a drone strike hits a medical-supply tent inside the Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital compound in Deir al-Balah for the second time in a month, wounding 3; Gaza Health Ministry reports 10 bodies received in 48 hrs, ceasefire-period toll reaches 1,313 killed, 4,361 wounded. Aug 28: Israeli strikes kill 5 in Gaza — 3 from the Abdeen family in a drone strike north of Khan Younis, Hassan al-Deiri in a Sabra (Gaza City) drone missile strike, and 1 more in a Mashahra tent strike; IDF claims (without evidence) it killed Hamas operative Qais Bitawi and two Hamas/PIJ commanders. Aug 27: Israeli strikes kill 3 more Palestinians — a tent near Shati camp west of Gaza City (IDF says it killed Hamas anti-tank cmdr Bilal Raqi'i), a drone strike on a displacement tent in al-Mawasi, Khan Younis (IDF says it killed Hamas Khan Younis Brigade member Azzam Abadala), and a drone strike on an electric bicycle at the Al-Sinaa intersection in Gaza City; Defense Minister Katz renews threat to evacuate Gaza areas over kite launches. Aug 26: Palestinian Health Ministry reports 7 killed in 24 hrs (5 new, 2 died of earlier wounds), plus separate drone strikes kill 1 more in a Khan Younis displacement tent and 1 more near the Ansar junction west of Gaza City; ceasefire-period toll reaches 1,303 killed, 4,336 wounded; Board of Peace envoy Mladenov warns UN Security Council of a ceasefire 'point of no return.' Aug 25: Israeli strikes kill 7 — 3 in a Beit Lahiya home strike near Kamal Adwan Hospital, 1 in an al-Mawasi (Khan Younis) drone strike, 3 from earlier wounds; a warehouse holding child-nutrition aid destroyed; Israel expels Dutch reps from the Kiryat Gat Gaza coordination center over a Dutch settlement-goods import ban. Aug 24: Strikes hit a mosque and desalination plant in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan area and destroy the historic Abu Salim Mosque in Deir al-Balah (IDF says it targeted Hamas weapons storage); a Bureij refugee camp strike kills 4-year-old Hassan al-Hafi; separately IDF strikes kill 2 Hamas militants in Deir al-Balah, one an Oct 7 Nukhba fighter. Aug 23: Netanyahu and Katz threaten to 'intensify strikes' over kites landing near Nahal Oz; IAF strikes kill Hamas weapons-production cmdr Abu Ful in Maghazi and a 4-year-old boy in Az-Zawayda near an aid site; Khan Younis shelled along the Yellow Line; Israel raises concerns about Hamas disarmament provisions in deal framework.

label: Palestinians Wounded (Gaza)
source: Gaza Ministry of Health / UNRWA / WAFA / IMEMC (Sep 20, 2026)
contestNote: Figures may undercount due to overwhelmed health system; 4,822+ wounded since Oct 2025 ceasefire alone. Sep 19-20: 4+ wounded in the Sheikh Radwan/Ar-Rashid Street vehicle strike (incl. 2 children), 1 more near Maghazi, 21 injured strip-wide in the 24 hrs to Sep 20. Sep 17-18: 28+ wounded strip-wide incl. Sheikh Ajlin drone strike (~10), Ad-Daraj School strike (2), and further wounded near Nasser Medical Complex, Khan Younis. 17 wounded Sep 7 strip-wide in 24 hrs, incl. 6 in the Rimal drone strike, 6 in the western Gaza City vehicle strike, and others near Bureij, Nuseirat and Khan Younis. 31 wounded Sep 2 strip-wide in 24 hrs incl. several in the Jabalia drone strike/gunfire; 8 wounded Sep 1 in the Shin Bet raid and covering IAF strikes in Al Katiba, Gaza City. Several wounded Aug 31 in the Gaza City municipal-park drone strike; also Aug 31 minor injuries reported from Israeli warboat fire on fishermen off Gaza City, gunfire/shrapnel in Khan Younis, and a critically wounded woman in Deir al-Balah. Several more wounded Aug 29 in the Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital warehouse drone strike (3) and Aug 30 Deir al-Balah strike.

contestNote: ~90% of Gaza's 2.1M population displaced at peak

label: Hostages Remaining in Gaza
source: Hostages and Missing Families Forum / IDF
contestNote: All 251 hostages accounted for by Jan 26, 2026: ~105 released Nov 2023 truce, 33 in Phase 1 (Jan 2025), 20 alive + 28 bodies in Oct 2025 deal, remainder died in captivity or rescued

label: Structures Destroyed/Damaged in Gaza
contestNote: By late 2024, est. 60% of all structures damaged or destroyed

label: Aid Trucks Entering Gaza (daily avg)
contestNote: Aid inflows declined 37% from Jan 11–Apr 11 vs. first three months of ceasefire: <105,000 metric tons vs. 167,600 metric tons required. ~102–122 trucks/day entering mid-April vs. 600+ needed. Zikim Crossing reopened Apr 12 on alternating days; Kerem Shalom (Karem Abu Salem) primary active crossing; Kissufim remains closed. Jordan B2B route: 60 trucks twice weekly. Fuel compliance at 14%. 2026 Flash Appeal $4.1B req, only 9.7% funded. ~129 community kitchens serve 1.25M meals/day. Gaza Government Media Office said Aug 6, 2026 only ~35% of expected aid trucks have entered Gaza since the Oct 2025 ceasefire, alongside 4,091 documented ceasefire violations over 300 days.

label: Healthcare Facilities Damaged/Destroyed
contestNote: All 36 hospitals in Gaza damaged or destroyed; ~16 partially functional at peak. Gaza Health Ministry Director-General Dr. Munir al-Bursh warned Aug 25, 2026 that only 12 of 34 oxygen stations remain operational and just 4 of 30 cylinder-refill devices still function, threatening ICU, neonatal, and pediatric intensive care units.

label: Population at IPC Phase 5 (Catastrophe) Risk
contestNote: Israel disputes famine characterization. OCHA's Justin Brady said ~10% of Gaza's population is now on the edge of starvation (Aug 2026); persistent famine risk despite some improvement since the August 2025 famine confirmation in Gaza governorate. Families generally survive on one nutritionally poor meal/day; some go entire days without eating, relying on rationing, borrowing, and scavenging. Aid access remains limited by looting and militarized distribution. 2026 Flash Appeal seeks $4.1B for 3.6M people across Gaza and the West Bank; still severely underfunded.
